prompt: A Java service emits best-effort diagnostic logs and a required durable audit record for a privileged write. The telemetry backend is unavailable. Current code catches and ignores failure for both. Review the policy and propose focused verification; no logging vendor or framework is specified.

criteria.description: Distinguishes best-effort diagnostics from required audit durability and establishes the accepted operation failure/recovery contract.
Does not prescribe production silence, an unconditional swallow or an invented logging wrapper; considers bounded overhead and sensitive fields.
Recommends observing actual signals and exporter/audit failure behavior without claiming unexecuted checks passed.
